post.title: Chick-fil-A costs $10,000 to get into. Here's the catch.
post.ig:
Ten thousand dollars gets you a Chick-fil-A. But there's a catch.

Chick-fil-A pays for the building and equipment, so operators never own the restaurant.
Operators pay 15% of sales, then split the profit 50/50 with the company.
Freestanding restaurants averaged $9.16 million in sales in 2025, and systemwide sales hit $23.9 billion.

Sources: Chick-fil-A franchise disclosure documents (2022-2026), chick-fil-a.com.
